batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b M Morkel

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c M Morkel b PP Chawla

batting.name: MG Johnson
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b SP Narine

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b P Awana

balls.text: chipped to long-on. They try to run two, but Akshar is way out of his crease and the fielder did well to throw to the batsman's end.
down the pitch, and Narine's offbreak spins past his swishing blade. Uthappa stumps him easily.
slog-sweep, didn't connect as well as he'd have hoped, but it goes for six anyway. Lands right on top of the rope.
flicked off his toes, and he hit it well. Morne Morkel had come in from deep midwicket, and was in no position as it sails over him and bounces over the rope.
slow, loopy offbreak this time, turns past Johsnon's bat as he tries to slog.
tries to reverse-sweep, beaten by the offbreak.
Bailey had taken guard outside leg. Umesh bowled it outside off, and the batsman has to reach for it to slap it down to long-off.
bouncer, Johnson sways out of the way, sees Bailey running, and sets off himself. Uthappa misses the stumps at the keeper's end.
slower ball, cramps Bailey for room, and he pokes it down to long-on.
length ball, slower ball maybe, just outside off. Toe-ends it to point.
full toss goes screaming across Johnson, wide of off. Throws his bat at it and misses.
length ball, on leg, Narine fumbles that clip at short fine leg.
leg stump, slightly shorter, and Johnson clips it square off his pads.
Another offbreak. Mitch comes further forward, but still can't put bat on ball.
big offbreak. Mitch was frozen in a forward defensive and it spins sharply past his bat.
goes across, works this offbreak to deep square leg.
gives himself room, tries to cut, finds short third man again.
midwicket was on the boundary, and Bailey walked across and flicked it towards him, but not too hard.
bowled him! skids on again, hits off stump as Dhawan tries to sweep it square.
slog-sweep, from outside off. Didn't get any elevation on it, and it goes rolling to deep midwicket.
another skidder, Dhawan opens his face and hits it to the right of Kallis at short third man.
skids on again, no room at all, and Bailey bunts it towards cover.
tossed up, Bailey went back to cut, it skidded on, hits it straight to short third man.
tossed up, nice and slow, comes forward to push it in front of cover.
length ball, aimed for top of off, made room to dab it behind point.
length ball, angled towards the stumps. Dhawan goes back to defend.
full ball, angled in from outside off, pushed to wide mid-off.
full, outside off, slashed off the front foot behind square.
got him! that was an offcutter, and it sneaked between bat and pad as Miller played across it. Crashed into middle stump.
angled across, bit of width, and Miller slaps it hard through cover point.
tossed up again, outside off, and Bailey walks across his crease to flick it into the square leg area.
pushed to long-off with a straight bat. Full ball just outside off.
tossed up towards middle, Bailey works it down to long-on.
whoops. Sehwag comes down the track this time, slogs, and inside edges onto off stump.
tries to make room again, but hits it straight to point.
flighted, outside off. Sehwag makes room, but gets an inside edge that rolls past leg stump.
full, no room for Miller, punches it off the front foot to cover.
short ball outside off, Sehwag jumps and drops it down towards the off side.
length ball, outside off. Sehwag was possibly trying to steer it towards point, gets a thick edge that flies away fine.
full, drifting onto leg stump, and Sehwag tickles it fine.
Miller steps down the pitch, and is squared up by the angle, edges this ball behind point.
In the blockhole, on off stump, steered to point.
cuts again, but is cramped for room, goes rolling down to deep point.
slow, loopy, on off stump, checked drive into the covers.
short, but no width, chopped to deep point.
swept hard, but well stopped by Kallis on the slide after running to his right from fine leg.
turns in from outside off, tries to flick it hard to long-on, but Chawla dives to his left and cuts it off.
short, outside leg, pulled to the left of deep square leg.
back of a length outside off, heaved to long-on.
gives himself room to slash through the off side, is beaten.
tries to pull, comes in off the pitch and keeps a bit low, hits him on the pad. Going down.
length ball, outside off, Sehwag clears his front leg slightly and tees off over the bowler's head.
short, wide, chopped away to the sweeper on the off side.
gentle offcutter, and Miller is looking for the cut but is so early on it that he hits it on his follow-through, down to the bowler
Outside off, a touch short, but deep point is in place to cut off the cut.
that wasn't too short, but Sehwag tries to pull anyway, and top-edges it loopily over the bowler's head.
another loopy delivery, on middle-and-off, worked away towards midwicket.
and he's gone. This won't be Maxwell's day. slog-sweeps uppishly, straight to Morne Morkel on the deep square leg boundary.
flighted legbreak outside off, bit of turn, and Sehwag swats it wide of long-on.
flighted onto middle stump, Maxwell flicks it to deep midwicket.
slower ball, outside off, and it looked like Sehwag was only looking for the single to third man, but that open-faced slice is timed so well it races to the boundary well in front of the fielder.
full toss, punched away to the left of long-off.
length ball, just outside off, Sehwag flicks on the jump, to deep midwicket, in that typically Sehwag-ish manner and walks the single that gets him his half-century.
full, wide outside off, Maxwell slogs it to long-on.
risky, gets away with it. length ball outside off, and he slogs it hard and flat, bounces just short of Yusuf at long on and goes over the rope.
Kallis gets another ball to straighten. Sehwag was looking to flick off the back foot. It loops to the bowler's left off his leading edge.
straightens, Maxwell's bottom hand comes off as he chips it over cover. May have been looking to hit it straighter.
length ball outside off, opens his face and pushes it to deep point.
shortish ball, goes straight on with the angle after pitching, Maxwell wrists it down to long-on.
full, angled in, worked away with a bit of wrist to long-on.
length ball, angling towards leg, flicked in front of square, and Sehwag does well to run two.
bit of bounce here, and Sehwag gets a thick outside edge as he pushes uncertainly at it. Runs away for four to the third man region.
length ball, outside off, Sehwag waits on it and dabs it to third man.
slower ball, just outside off, Viru picks it up early and launches it over the long-off boundary.
ball moves away after pitching, from well outside off. Sehwag slashes without moving his feet, doesn't connect.
short, pulled to deep square leg.
another slower ball, Sehwag lofts it high and straight. Ten Doeschate runs to his right from mid-off, makes a sprawling dive, but it falls just out of reach.
slower ball outside off. Sehwag tries the cute dab to third man, misses.
even more turn this time, away from the batsman again. Maxwell comes forward, pushes at it, misses by a long way.
carrom ball outside off, Maxwell slogs and misses.
full, on middle stump, Sehwag pushes it to long on.
straightens outside off, and Maxwell cuts it to deep point.
another offbreak, straighter this time, worked behind square.
turns in from outside off, flicked to deep square leg.
angles in towards middle. Sehwag stays next to the line and pushes it to mid-off.
drifts onto Sehwag's pads, and Ten Doeschate saves what could have been a boundary, diving to his left at midwicket.
back of a length, outside off, goes past Sehwag's bat as he opens his face and tries to run it square.
flicked to deep square leg, from outside off, with an extravagant follow-through.
back of a length outside off, Maxwell wafts at it and is beaten.
Got him! back of a length, angling in. Saha tries to chop it into the off side, but only gets an inside-edge onto the stumps.
full, on off stump, angling in, Saha comes forward and knocks it wristily to mid-on.
full, wide, slapped over cover, and it bounces away towards the vacant boundary.
short, angling down the leg side, Saha crouches a bit and pulls it away to the left of Narine, who makes little effort to dive or chase.
Angled in to middle-and-off on a good length, pushed towards mid on.
slower ball, down the leg side again. What is this, Umesh?

short, on off, Saha swivels to pull, and the ball goes miles in the air before dropping between the keeper and short fine leg. Uthappa chased it, but it was probably closer to Sunil Narine at short fine.
Full, wide, Saha doesn't get across, gets it away off the toe-end to third man.
full, on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket.
Angled in this time, and Sehwag has to bring his bat down quickly. It hits his front pad just outside off, just before hitting his bat. Muted appeal from Morkel.
back of a length, outside off. Sehwag lets it go.
good ball again. Full, but not on a driving length, outside off, and it beats Sehwag with bounce as he throws his bat at it.

Uthappa drops it! Sehwag pushed lazily forward and poked at this outside off. It left him and took a thick edge. Uthappa dives and gets the edge of his glove to it, but he seemed to move a little late.
good length, just outside off, Sehwag lets it go.
drifts down the leg side again, and Sehwag might have missed out there. Hits him low on the front pad.
short ball, Saha saw the width but had to change his stroke hurriedly as it came back in off the pitch. Opens the face and runs it to third man.
leg-stump yorker, flicked to midwicket.
Full, on off stump. Sehwag opens his face and tries to place it past point, but finds the fielder instead.
full, and way down the leg side. How can you bowl like that with fine leg in the circle? Sehwag sends it screaming away with a flick of his wrists.
drifts onto middle and leg, and Sehwag flicks it past midwicket, but doesn't hit it all that well.
short, wide, crashed away to the point boundary.
beauty. Saha pokes at this, playing the inward angle, and it straightens off the pitch and beats him. Extra bounce as well.
Full, almost in the blockhole, on off stump. Saha defends with a straight bat.
he's gone. Slightly shorter than the previous ball, straightened a touch perhaps, Mandeep tries to square-cut off the front foot, and gets a thick edge to the keeper.
Angled in onto a good length outside off. Mandeep stretches forward to defend.
Full, angled in, flicked towards midwicket.
drifts onto leg again, and Sehwag's glance easily beats short fine leg.
Could have been another wide, but Sehwag walks across and half-pulls, half-helps it away behind square for another four. Poor start from Kallis.
better line, better length. In the corridor, and Sehwag goes back to defend.
drifts onto the pads again. It's full, not that quick, and Sehwag flicks it away easily past square leg.
bangs it in short, angles it in, and Sehwag lets it pass outside leg.
Wide again, but he's pulled his length back a touch, and Sehwag is beaten playing the same shot.
Full and wide, and Sehwag comes forward and flays it through the covers. Poor ball to start with.
slower ball, and Pandey yells "yes, yes, yes!" as he wrists it to the right of mid-on. He sprints through, and would have probably beaten the throw, which missed the stumps anyway.
punched to cover, and Maxwell throws at the bowler's end again. He misses again, and they walk an overthrow.
short, Gambhir swats it with an almost vertical bat to the right of deep backward square leg.
short, flat-batted pull to deep midwicket.
short, slower ball, Pandey mistimes his pull, and Maxwell sprinting from midwicket, underarms it at the unmanned stumps and misses, giving away two overthrows.
full and straight, Pandey uses his wrists to play the pick-up shot over midwicket.
Gambhir gets on his toes, tucks it off his hips, behind square.
wristy push down to long-on.
dropped! Short, Gambhir top-edges his pull, and it drops into Bailey's hands at midwicket and pops back out.
another slower ball, onto the pads, tucked away to deep backward square.
slower ball, fullish, on off. Gambhir swipes it to long-on.
worked towards long-on, and the batsmen aren't running too quickly. Mitch picks it up and releases quickly. They go to the third umpire for the direct hit at the bowler's end but Pandey is safe.
works it down to wide long on.
short, wide, rubbish ball, and Gambhir's punch sends it soaring over cover and well away from a sprinting long-off. Gambhir raises his bat. Third fifty of the season.
down the track, chips it to deep midwicket.
pulled down to long-on
Gambhir set off as soon as Pandey pushed that to cover, even though it went straight to Bailey, but Akshar didn't collect his throw cleanly.
shortish ball, angled in, Pandey is deep in his crease to punch to mid off.
length ball on leg stump, worked away into the on side.

another slower legcutter, and Pandey opens his face to guide it to Mandeep's right at point. He dives, the ball ricochets off his right hand and the sweeper throws to the bowler's end. There was a bit of hesitation, but Dhawan missed the throw and disturbed the bails with his hands instead.
slower ball, Gambhir clips it to deep midwicket.
short, sits up, and Gambhir's pulled it, one bounce over the rope between long on and deep midwicket.
straight, full, flicked to deep midwicket.
gives himself room, slaps it to mid-off.
clears his front leg and swipes it to deep midwicket.
this one's closer to off stump and he tries to cut again and misses again.
tries to cut - the width is there but he's beaten.
pushed towards cover, where Bailey makes a diving stop to his left.
lovely. tossed up, and Pandey is nowhere near the pitch as he prods forward outside off. Ball turns away and beats him.
cut straight to backward point, who is right back on the circle.
another slower ball. Gambhir bunts it down into the leg side.
tries to flick this slower ball that is headed down leg, and is hit on the front pad instead.
clears his front leg again and swipes to deep square leg. It wasn't short enough to pull.
what a shot that is. Gets his front leg out of the way, stands up and punches it with a straight bat back past the bowler.
short, outside off, Pandey clears his front leg and pulls towards deep midwicket, where Akshar makes a diving stop.
back of a length, tight on off stump, Pandey stays beside the line but can only push it to cover.
down the leg side this time, worked behind square leg.
tosses it wide of off stump. Comes forward to drive it to cover.
worked towards deep midwicket.
slips down the leg side trying to compensate.
not that short, not that wide, but Gambhir is back in his crease to cut it to the right of backward point.
lifts this over cover, long-off runs to his right and cuts it off short of the rope.
gives himself room, chops it towards deep point.
ball goes with the angle from outside off, defensive push towards the covers.
gives himself room to cut it to deep point.
shortish, wide, cuts and misses.
stops on him a bit, pushed uppishly to long-off.
pushed to mid on.
goes with the angle, and Pandey jumps up and jams his bat down on it.
flicked towards midwicket from outside off.
goes over the same fielder, this time with the flick, and deep square leg runs around and cuts it down to two.
swatted away from well outside off over midwicket.
ball stops on Gambhir, and the leading edge pops into the off side, nowhere near Miller at cover.
slower ball, pushed down to long-on.
slower ball, outside leg, clipped to deep square leg.
banged in, angled across from wide of the crease. Gambhir leans back to make room and chops down on it to hit it to third man.
cut hard, to the right of point and to the left of a helplessly sprinting third man.
tries to steer this past point. Bounces up and Maxwell fields it well, stretching his arms high above his head. Misses the throw at the bowler's end. Gambhir would have been miles out.
hugs that off-stump line, and Pandey pushes it awkwardly back to the bowler.
bit of movement away, Pandey comes down the track and is beaten on the poke.
It's close to off stump, and Gambhir gives himself a bit of room to chop it to third man.
length ball, angling into off stump, pushed to cover.
waits on it and chops it down to third man.
shortish, on leg stump, swatted away to deep backward square leg.
fullish, angled across Gambhir, who steers it to deep point.
angled in towards off stump, comes forward and opens his face to steer it to deep point.
Wide outside off, full, lets it go.
he timed that too well! Awana drifts onto the pads again, and Uthappa picks it up and hits it over the leg side, Akshar runs to his left to take a good catch at deep midwicket.
dabs it down to third man with an open bat face.
short, bit of width, and Gambhir plays that favourite slash of his past a diving backward point.
full, drifts onto leg stump, but deep square leg is there to cut off the flick.
straightens a bit from outside off, and Uthappa gets a thick edge down to the third man boundary.
angled way down the leg side
full, on off, flicked neatly to midwicket's left.
driven with a straight bat to mid-on.
down the track, chipped cleverly over mid-on, who has no chance of cutting it off running back.
Awana misfields this cut at point. It was hit straight to him, not particularly hard.
bit of bounce, and the attempted reverse-sweep ends up in the batsman gloving the ball into his helmet.
tries to make room, but it skids on. Knocks it down into the off side.
length ball, angled into the stumps, Uthappa reverse-sweeps straight to point.
punched off the back foot, straight to a deepish cover point.
length ball on off, Gambhir tries to give himself room but doesn't manage to find too much of it. His slash goes uppishly and drops just out of reach of a diving Mandeep at cover point.
short ball, banged into the crease, Gambhir pulls away from it and it loops down into Saha's gloves.
angled across, looks to give himself room and guide it behind point. Finds the fielder.
short, angling across, Gambhir pulls it high, drops just short of the rope and rolls into it slowly.
down the track, doesn't get hold of this slower ball outside off. Trickles into the off side.
superb stop from Mandeep, diving to his right at point to cut off this firm front-foot push from Gambhir.
full, on leg-and-middle, and Uthappa flicks it nonchalantly square on the leg side. Mitch was holding the ball cross-seam as he ran in.
drifts down the leg side now, and Uthappa glances it neatly to the left of a diving wicketkeeper.
length ball, room outside off, and Uthappa swings his arms through to flat-bat it into the gap between the bowler and mid-off.
angled across the right-hander, checked push to cover.
It's short, and Uthappa top-edges his pull way over third man.
full and wide, and Gambhir slices it uppishly but wide of point.
full, outside off, solid drive to mid-off.
bit of away swing, but Robin shows the full face and times that straight push exquisitely past the bowler.
length ball, outside off. Uthappa is across to defend it to mid-on.
down the track, gets to the pitch, and places it beautifully with a straight bat to the left of wide mid-off.
wide outswinger, Uthappa pushes forward and is beaten on the drive.
drifts onto the pads, and Uthappa flicks it sweetly, sends it hurtling away to the left of deep square leg, who has no chance.
similar delivery, different result. He gets hold of it and sends it over the leg side and rolling beyond the vacant midwicket boundary.
short, outside off, Gambhir is beaten on the pull.
straightens from middle and off. Hits the outside half of Gambhir's bat, but he plays it safely down into the off side.
bit of inswing from back of a length. Uthappa stays back, plays late, pushes it into the off side.
short, outside leg, and Uthappa gets a little tickle on it down to fine leg.
flicked to the left of mid-on from outside off.
slight inswing. Uthappa pushes it towards midwicket.
goes the other way this time, and Uthappa is on the walk as he is beaten outside off.
swings away from Gambhir, but he flicks it solidly, playing outside the line, in front of midwicket.
pushes to mid-off and sets off quickly for one.
inswing again, lots of it, and Uthappa is beaten on the inside as he swishes his bat down with that KP-style curtain-rail batswing.
bit of inswing from outside off. Uthappa drives to mid-off.
